notes: The manual text is a draft and does not give the exact Raspberry Pi pins or show a circuit image; only that the PIR's three pins connect to the Pi.
Assumed standard wiring: VCC to 5V (pin 2, 5V.1), GND to GND.1 (pin 6), OUT to GPIO14 (the pin used in the Raspberry Pi Foundation PIR project). The OUT pin can be any free GPIO.
No breadboard is mentioned, so the PIR's pins are wired directly to the Pi header with jumper wires (female-to-female in reality; modelled with the generic jumper-wire type).
Pin order of the PIR (VCC, OUT, GND) follows the catalogue entry; the manual doesn't label the pins. Check the module's silkscreen, since some modules order them differently.
